title: limeum fenestratum var. frutescens
intro: Limeum fenestratum var. frutescens, commonly known as Frutescent Limeum, is a plant species that belongs to the Limeum genus. It is known for its therapeutic properties and has been used in traditional medicine for various health benefits. The plant is said to possess anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, making it effective in treating various health conditions, including wounds, infections, and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of Frutescent Limeum include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions.
